note: Traces exported from the repository's hermetic fixtures — no live model calls.

scenarios.one_liner: A naive machine auto-closes the case; the real gate pauses for the reviewer, who rejects it.
scenarios.title: A/B — human decision gate (ADR-078)

scenarios.one_liner: Mid-committee, the Judge asks the on-call reviewer an advisory question and finalises in the same run.
scenarios.title: Committee asks the reviewer (sync consultation)

scenarios.one_liner: The engine pauses at a non-clean verdict; only the reviewer's decision approves the case.
scenarios.title: Human decision gate (pause + approve)

scenarios.one_liner: The engine pauses at a non-clean verdict; the reviewer declines and the case reaches VALIDATION_rejected.
scenarios.title: Human decision gate (pause + reject)

scenarios.one_liner: A Judge flags an anomaly without verified evidence; the engine mechanically strips the unsupported tag.
scenarios.title: Unsupported Judge claim blocked

scenarios.one_liner: The committee rests a refusal on sex; the guard strips the basis and the refusal goes with it.
scenarios.title: Barred basis stripped (Test-Achats)

scenarios.one_liner: A refusal is proposed on the statutory basic tariff, where a contracting obligation means refusal is not an available outcome.
scenarios.title: Refusal with nowhere to land (VVG §193(5))

scenarios.one_liner: Risk points sit beside an acceptance boundary, so the case is argued and then referred to a named assessor.
scenarios.title: Where the rules run out (E6 — borderline)

scenarios.one_liner: A report records a BMI the application does not; the committee proposes a catalogued exclusion and the guards leave it standing.
scenarios.title: Evidence against declaration (E3)

scenarios.one_liner: A mistyped claims ratio is caught deterministically and the sender receives one remediation email.
scenarios.title: Arithmetic rule catch (R1 — claims-ratio identity)

scenarios.one_liner: A claims-ratio spike that breaks no hard rule is escalated to the committee and flagged for review.
scenarios.title: Committee escalation on a statistical anomaly

scenarios.one_liner: A third-party medical report with no recorded consent fails the case before a single risk factor is examined.
scenarios.title: Unlawfully assembled case (A15 — VVG §213)

scenarios.one_liner: An application declaring 'never smoked' alongside twenty a day is caught by arithmetic before any lookup or model.
scenarios.title: Deterministic catch (A11 — declared non-smoker)

scenarios.one_liner: A clean individual health application passes every deterministic check and completes with no model and no assessor.
scenarios.title: Individual cover — straight through

scenarios.one_liner: A compliant submission passes every check deterministically and completes in seconds with zero reviewer touch.
scenarios.title: Compliant Submission — Straight Through Pass

scenarios.one_liner: A workbook that isn't a VC template is rejected loudly at parse time — before any tier runs and before a case exists.
scenarios.title: Malformed workbook rejected at intake
